## Scope

- The PR changes one test, `a_client_that_keeps_talking_is_never_dropped_as_idle` in `crates/app/tests/mcp_live.rs`. It also adds `docs/decisions/3230-live-idle-test.md`.
- No production code changes. No posted G-code, gouge or collision check, stock simulation or geometry changes. This is not a safety-tier review.
- No `crates/ui` change, so screenshots are not necessary.
- No process file, `build.rs`, script, workflow or dependency changes.

## What looks good

- The test now synchronizes through the owner side (`inbox.next()` and `req.answer`). It does not depend on client sleeps. The next ping goes into the socket before the current answer is released. Thus client scheduling cannot add an idle gap.
- The test stays a strong check:
  - It sends eight replies, with `window / 4` in each owner turn. The total time is at least two windows (asserted).
  - Without the activity refresh, the initial window expires before the last call.
  - The negative control on the same connection requires an idle notice and EOF. It also requires that at least one window passes after the last answer.
- All waits have a limit of `window * 3`. A failure cannot hang the suite.
- The decision file obeys the format. The PR body names what was not exercised (Windows).

## Results, trial-merged with upstream/main `c79c9b24fc0a00386ba1c74b8a0a900ff7e89193` (locally, macOS arm64, 16 jobs)

The trial merge was clean.

| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | ok |
| `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` (6 steps, release) | ok, 0 failed |

Extra suites run: none were necessary. The diff does not touch `testdata/`, a fixture, a golden directory or the importer code. No post, operation, motion or catalog change, so `example_catalog` is not necessary. No recorded program moved.

Heavy lanes: not run. They are not a merge condition, and this test-only diff reaches none.

## Mutations (each reverted after the run; `git status` clean)

1. Removed the activity refresh after a forwarded line (`crates/app/src/mcp/listen.rs:339`, `active = Instant::now();`). Result: **red**. The test failed at `mcp_live.rs:382`, "call N did not reach the owner", because the listener dropped the active client at the initial window.
2. Disabled idle expiry (`listen_with_idle` forced `idle` to `Duration::ZERO`, `listen.rs:143`). Result: **red**. The test failed at `mcp_live.rs:427`, `idle notice after activity stops: ... WouldBlock`.

Both results agree with the negative controls in the PR body. On macOS the first mutation fails at a different assertion than on Linux (`ConnectionReset`), but the test is red in each case.

- `crates/app/tests/mcp_live.rs` was 710 lines on main. With this PR it has 764 lines. The suite has a submodule `mcp_live/idle_timeout.rs`. A later change can move this idle test there. Suggested follow-up level: P7.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
